text: Bhai 4 ghante se airport pe baithe hain, koi water bhi offer nahi kar raha.
Kya baat hai SpiceJet, 5 ghante delay aur bol rahe hain technical glitch hai. Shabash!
Mera bag baggage carousel pe 2 ghante se gayab hai, staff bol raha wait karo.
Refund ka status 3 weeks se pending dikha raha hai, customer care phone disconnect kar raha.
Super fast service! Only waited 6 hours at the boarding gate 🙃
Best luggage handling ever, suitcase came out in two broken pieces!
Pilot ne itni smooth landing karayi, truly grateful to the SpiceJet crew!
Boarding pass download karne mein website error de rahi hai, kaise check-in karun?
Thanks for cancelling without informing, loved spending my anniversary night on terminal floor.
Great job leaving our bags in Delhi while we landed in Mumbai! Top tier efficiency 👍
Gate change ho gaya aur koi announcement bhi nahi ki, poora terminal bhagna pada.
Waah, ticket cancel hone ke baad cancellation fee bhi kaat li. Gazab logic hai!
